title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: Double-decker Tb/Dy phthalocyanines place Ln3+ between two parallel Pc rings in an approximate D4d sandwich.
explanation: The review presents LnPc2 (Ln = Tb, Dy) as the most studied Pc SMMs: the ion sits at the molecular center and the two Pc ligands form a sandwich of D4d symmetry. DyPc2 is described as similar to TbPc2, which has an anisotropic Ueff of 410 cm^-1 and J = 6.
scope: Neutral or anionic double-decker LnPc2 with Ln = Tb or Dy.
conditions: Crystal data cited for TbPc2 and DyPc2 are both orthorhombic with closely similar cell metrics (Table 1).
caveats: The angle between Pc rings is given only via a figure and is not reliably readable in the text.
